<!-- pr-reviewer: 55eecd47d3d1c7f4cd20d574101e6de65daf552f -->

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The PR adds one test file and changes no product code. All three bench tests are `#[ignore]`d, and each ignore reason names its heavy lane and the run command (`stock_play_cost_bench.rs:276,283,291`). The tests print readings and assert no wall time, so they cannot turn red on a slower machine.
- The bench builds the document through undoable commands only (`ImportModel`, `CreateSetup`, `SetStock`, `CreateOperation`, `EditOperationParams`, `GenerateOperation`). No direct field writes.
- The copied chunk law matches the worker: `CHUNK_TARGET` 15 ms, first chunk 64, 1..1024 (`crates/app/src/stock_play_worker.rs:66-70`).
- Placement is right: the file sits in `crates/app/tests/`, imports items `crates/app/src` defines, and its Gate map names `app::stock_play`, `app::stock_view` and `sim::stock_sim::preview` through the app path. No new crate dependency. Provenance line present. The file is 300 lines.
- Numeric paths are guarded: `max(1)`, `max(1e-9)`, `unwrap_or_default`, saturating arithmetic. The `.expect()` calls are inside a test binary, which the law allows.
- Links are correct: `Fixes #3365` (the bench issue), `Refs #3336` (the umbrella stays open). `Changelog: none` fits a tests-only PR.

## Results

- Built on the self-hosted runner (macOS), merged with main: run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45017592959, main `62353ac75`. Trial merge: clean. Quick gate: green, 1 step `app suites: stock_play_cost_bench` (38 s, 0 failed; all three tests ignored, so none ran in the default plan). Clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The diff adds no `cfg(windows)` line and no per-OS value, so no local Windows re-run was owed. The three reds of #3384 did not appear: the plan holds only the changed suite.
- Heavy lane run checked locally: the trial merge in a review worktree, `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run`.

## Heavy lanes

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --dry-run` reaches one lane: `app heavy: stock_play_cost_bench` (the new file). The PR body names a green author run of all three tests in release on this head. The head and the reached lane match, so this review relies on the author run.

## Requested before merge

- None.

## Notes and questions (not blocking)

- The body says "The two default tests: three runs in debug, all pass". The file has no default test: all three are `#[ignore]`d, and the body's own quick-gate line says "no test runs". One line of the body needs a fix.
- The three benches have no light twin (#2569). A bench prints readings and judges nothing, so a twin would measure without asserting. This is a question, not a gap: if the light lane should carry a playback reading, add one test with a small budget, un-ignored.
- The chunk law is a copy, not an import (`stock_play_cost_bench.rs:38-40`); the comment names the source file. If `stock_play_worker.rs` changes its law, the bench drifts. A follow-up could make the three constants `pub(crate)`-visible to tests, at most `P7`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
